capability.summary: Run `go test -cover ./...` from a Go project path and return combined textual test and per-package coverage output
capability.description: Uses a supplied directory as the working directory or a supplied file's parent, then compiles and runs all recursively matched Go packages with basic coverage reporting. It returns nonblank stdout/stderr lines and a passed boolean, but no coverage profile or parsed metrics.
capability.problem_space: Execution of recursive Go package tests with basic `-cover` text; not static coverage analysis, coverprofile generation, line-level uncovered-code mapping, structured metric extraction, or a no-execution report reader.

env_requirements: go executable and a compatible Go toolchain
project dependencies and any runtime services required by the tests
constraint.io_signature: Input: one required existing Go project directory or file whose parent becomes the working directory; output: JSON with Go's exit code, pass boolean, and combined nonblank stdout/stderr lines.
accepted_inputs: an existing Go module or package directory from which `go test -cover ./...` can run
an existing file path whose parent directory should be used as the Go test working directory
constraint.output_shape: After any completed Go process: {status: "success", tool: "go test", target: string, exit_code: integer, passed: boolean, output: string[]}; output is nonblank lines from stdout followed by stderr, and passed is true only for exit_code 0. The wrapper itself exits 0 even for failed tests or Go command errors. Non-existing input: {status: "error", message: string} and exit 2. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON. Missing Go executable, 300-second timeout, and other subprocess exceptions are uncaught and may produce a traceback.
limitations: always runs `go test -cover ./...` with no package selection, test filter, count, race, tags, covermode, coverpkg, timeout, or passthrough flags
does not create a coverprofile or parse package percentages into structured coverage metrics or identify uncovered lines
always emits status=success after a completed subprocess and does not propagate nonzero Go exits; consumers must inspect passed and exit_code
executes project test code and compilation, may populate Go caches or trigger test-defined side effects, combines stdout before stderr, and has a fixed 300-second subprocess timeout

output_contract.description: JSON run summary with working directory, Go exit code, pass flag, and combined textual `go test -cover ./...` output; no coverprofile is produced.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: run recursive Go tests with basic package coverage
collect go test -cover output for all packages
negative_intents: generate or analyze a Go coverprofile
run Go tests without coverage or with custom test flags
statically inspect Go formatting source or uncovered lines without executing tests
